name: extractCostGroupMetaDataForExternalAppsUsingGET
title: extractCostGroupMetaDataForExternalAppsUsingGET
description: Search for cost-group documents associated with line items for which awards or PIRs are created by specifying a date range.

parameters.name: realm
parameters.description: Provide unique name of the realm. Example “s4All”

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description:
$filter=expression. ‘expression’ is a combination of resource parameters, values. Operator ‘eq’ is used to link parameter and value. Operator ‘and’ is used to link two or more parameters. For example, $filter=a eq ‘b’ and c ge 'd’. Following parameters are supported in current implementation.
date - get rfxCostgroups from given Date, ISO Format 2017-03-24T05:26:41
Valid combinations is
1. date ge '2017-03-24T05:26:41'

parameters.name: $top
parameters.description: $top is the number of items to be returned. maximum page size supported 40. Example 40

parameters.name: $skip
parameters.description: $skip is the number of items to be skipped. Example 0

parameters.name: $count
parameters.description: To return the number of elements in a collection inline. The syntax is $count=true. Example true
